title: Errand And Meeting

agents.persona: Resident with an errand who also promised to meet a friend.
agents.private_intention: Buy medicine at the pharmacy AND actually meet Casey at the market in-window; drop neither.
memory_seeds: Casey is at the market this evening.
Finishing the errand does not excuse skipping the meeting.

agents.persona: Friend at the market in the early evening.
agents.private_intention: See Aria if she makes it to the market.
memory_seeds: Casey is by the market entrance.

public_context: A tidy errand can crowd out the meeting; both outcomes are required.

architecture_probes.utility_planner: May complete the errand and skip the social outcome.
